IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_ewingsanimals_catadul: <LINE> <LINE> Ewing's Animals prototype: skittish adult cat. Eats cat food, meat and fish from the ground or troughs. Pure Cow Milk or Animal Milk can be offered through native hand feeding when hungry. Native menus may not offer solid cat foods. Water remains a separate need. Livestock zones encourage it to stay, but stressed or hungry animals can leave; close physical exits. No breeding or companion commands.
